global_rules.second_sentence: optional natural bridge only if supported by the actual post content
global_rules.template_usage_rule: Templates are style references only. Do not reuse their concrete nouns, scenes, or sample compliments unless those details are present in the current post.

categories.label: Homeowners / Residential
categories.context: Homeowner posts a backyard renovation, new home, pet in the yard, pool installation, or outdoor improvement.
categories.rule: Lead with a genuine reaction to their home or yard. Bridge to fencing only when the post shows a real reason: privacy, pets, pool safety, curb appeal, or finishing the outdoor space.

templates.template: The yard is coming together really nicely — that kind of space makes a home feel completely different. If fencing ends up being part of the plan, we install wood, vinyl, chain link, and iron around Chicago and the suburbs.
why: Starts with a specific reaction to their outdoor project
Positions fencing as a natural final piece, not a forced sales pitch
Mentions materials because homeowners often compare options

templates.trigger: New home announcement or just moved in
templates.template: Congrats on the new place — always a big step. If fencing lands on the to-do list, we handle residential installs around Chicago and can help compare options for the yard.
why: Connects to the realistic new-home to-do list
Keeps the offer helpful instead of pushy

templates.trigger: Dog or pet shown in the yard
templates.template: That pup looks like they already own the yard 🐾. A good fence makes a huge difference for keeping pets safe outside, especially in Chicago neighborhoods with shared alleys and close lots.
why: Reacts directly to the pet content
Frames fencing around safety, not selling

templates.template: That pool is going to be a great setup for summer. If you still need the safety fence handled, we install code-conscious pool fencing around Chicago and nearby suburbs.
why: Connects fencing to safety and compliance
Avoids legal overclaiming while staying relevant

categories.label: Real Estate Investors / Flippers
categories.context: Investor or flipper posts a before/after, rehab progress, new acquisition, listing prep, or rental property update.
categories.rule: Lead with recognition of the transformation or investment. Bridge to fencing as curb appeal, rental readiness, privacy, or exterior repair before listing.

templates.template: That transformation is strong — the exterior details can really finish the whole project. A new fence or fence repair can add a lot of curb appeal before photos or listing.
why: Frames fencing as a listing asset

templates.template: Nice pickup — looks like there is real potential there. If fencing is on the rehab list, we work with Chicago investors on wood, vinyl, chain link, iron, and gate installs.
why: Mentions relevant fence types without making a long service list

templates.template: Getting a rental cleaned up between tenants is always a project. Fence repair or replacement can be one of those details that makes the property feel more secure and ready.
why: Shows understanding of investor/property manager pain points

categories.label: General Contractors / Builders
categories.context: GC or builder posts progress on a build, exterior phase, renovation, crew work, or asks for subcontractors.
categories.rule: Lead with respect for the build. Bridge to fencing as a reliable exterior-phase subcontractor or final site/security component.

templates.template: Coming along nicely — looks like a solid project. If you need a fence sub for the exterior phase, we handle residential and commercial fencing around Chicago.
why: Uses contractor language: sub, exterior phase

templates.trigger: GC looking for subs or vendors
templates.template: We handle fencing in Chicago — wood, vinyl, chain link, iron, gates, residential and commercial. Happy to be considered for the vendor list if it lines up.
That finished up clean — exterior details always make the handoff feel more complete. We work with GCs on fence installs and replacements when the site is ready for final touches.
why: Keeps it relevant to contractor workflow

categories.label: Landscapers / Lawn Companies
categories.context: Landscaper posts backyard transformation, lawn project, hardscape, outdoor design, patio, or client yard improvement.
categories.rule: Lead with a compliment on the outdoor transformation. Bridge to fencing as a complementary service for clients who want privacy, pet safety, or a finished yard.

templates.template: That yard looks sharp — the whole space feels much more finished. If your clients ever ask about fencing to complete the backyard, we install all major fence types around Chicago.
why: Frames fencing as a client add-on

templates.template: The layout looks really well planned — hardscape plus fencing can completely change how a yard feels. We handle the fence side around Chicago if a project ever needs that final boundary.

categories.label: HOA / Property Managers
categories.context: HOA, property manager, landlord, multifamily owner, or condo association posts about property improvements, maintenance, security, tenant turnover, or community upgrades.
categories.rule: Lead with acknowledgement of the property/community improvement. Bridge to fencing as security, perimeter control, shared-area improvement, or large-scale residential install.

templates.template: Nice improvement — those details matter a lot for how a property feels day to day. If fencing ever comes up for the community or shared areas, we handle larger residential installs around Chicago.
why: Avoids sounding like a homeowner-only pitch

templates.template: Property maintenance always turns into a list fast. We handle fence repair, replacement, and gate work around Chicago when managers need the exterior secured again.
why: Shows understanding of property manager workload

categories.label: Commercial / Industrial Properties
categories.context: Commercial owner, industrial property, warehouse, logistics business, manufacturing site, or commercial real estate account posts a facility, yard, opening, expansion, or property update.
categories.rule: Lead with recognition of the business/property update. Bridge to fencing as perimeter security, access control, gates, chain link, or ornamental/commercial install.

templates.template: Congrats on the new space — that is a big move. If perimeter fencing or gates end up on the security list, we handle commercial installs around Chicago.

templates.trigger: Warehouse, industrial yard, or logistics site
templates.template: That kind of facility needs the exterior dialed in. We install chain link, security fencing, and gates around Chicago for commercial and industrial properties.
why: Mentions the most relevant fence types

banned_patterns.bad: We offer professional fencing services in Chicago!
banned_patterns.why: Sounds like an ad. No human talks like this in a comment.

banned_patterns.bad: Contact us today for the best fence installation prices!
banned_patterns.why: Hard CTA in a comment = spam pattern.

banned_patterns.bad: We specialize in wood fence, vinyl fence, chain link fence, iron fence, gates, repairs, replacements...
banned_patterns.why: Long lists kill the human feel. One context, one bridge.

banned_patterns.bad: DM us for a free quote! 🏡🔨🚧
banned_patterns.why: Overuse of emoji + DM push = classic spam pattern.

banned_patterns.bad: Great post! We are a local fence company based in Chicago IL serving...
